title: Property Management System Outage Response
description: Property Management System outages affecting hotel operations
triggers: Complete PMS outage affecting hotel operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on hotel operations and guest services
Implement manual guest procedures if needed
Contact hotel management for operational impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review PMS application logs and status
Verify network connectivity to hotel properties
resolution_steps: Restart PMS services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply PMS patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with PMS vendor for complex issues
verification: Test PMS functionality at affected properties
Confirm with hotel staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Guest-facing outages take precedence over back-office issues
Hotel property unable to check in guests is P1
Manual procedures may impact guest experience
Maintain guest service quality during system restoration
